- `django/utils/html.py` is the file that defines it, and it also calls it itself: in `format_html`, where keyword arguments go through `conditional_escape(v)`, and in `format_html_join` through `conditional_escape(sep)`. The `map(conditional_escape, args)` line passes the function as a value, but that doesn't matter because the file already counts from the other calls.
- `django/template/base.py`, `django/template/defaulttags.py`, `django/template/defaultfilters.py`, `django/template/library.py`, `django/template/backends/dummy.py`, `django/templatetags/static.py` and `django/contrib/admin/helpers.py` all import it by name from `django.utils.html` and call it. In `defaultfilters.py`, the line `escaper = conditional_escape` only passes it as a value, but the file also calls it directly elsewhere.

No file imports it under another name, imports the `django.utils.html` module itself, or does a star import from it, so nothing reaches it through an alias or a re-export. None of the matches are in test files.
